description: This is a PHP source file implementing a Trello REST API client class, providing methods for interacting with Trello objects such as boards, cards, and comments, with functionalities for initialization, fetching, and creating issues (cards).
external_files: bareBonesRestAPI (assumed base class, probably a local or external PHP file)

classes.name: trello
classes.description: A PHP class for interacting with Trello's REST API, including methods for managing cards, boards, comments, and configuration setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the trello API client with context parameters such as URL, API key, token, and optional configuration objects.

methods.name: getIssueURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a Trello issue (card) given its ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific Trello card by ID using the internal _get method.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Trello card with specified title and description, respecting the length limit.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to a specific Trello card.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Retrieves details of the specified board.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves list details from Trello, given a list ID.
